capabilities: Edit Markdown tables by inserting, deleting, moving, aligning and sorting rows and columns
Evaluate spreadsheet-style formulas with A1 cell references, ranges and functions
Render formula results and Excel-style column letters and row numbers in Live Preview and Reading Mode
Navigate table cells with Tab, Enter and sidebar toolbar commands
Export table cell text to CSV
disambiguation: Not a standalone spreadsheet app; formulas live inside Markdown tables and remain plain text in the note.
extras: README is developer-oriented: manual installation steps require building from source, community directory publication is unconfirmed, no automated test suite exists, and mobile/multi-window behavior plus compatibility with the declared minimum Obsidian version are explicitly unverified. Help documentation lives on GitHub and needs network access.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown tables are plain text that is hard to restructure and cannot compute values, so editing rows and columns or doing calculations inside a table is manual work.
summary: Markdown table editor with spreadsheet-style formula evaluation, cell navigation, sorting, and CSV export in Live Preview and Reading Mode.
